modalities.evidence: participants wore an ActiGraph GT3X+ on the non-dominant wrist for seven consecutive days
National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) is a nationally representative study that collects demographic, socioeconomic, dietary, and health-related information

output.population: All participants who wore accelerometers in NHANES 2011-2014
output.summary: Minute-level step counts derived from five algorithms applied to raw wrist accelerometry, plus activity counts, MIMS, and wear predictions, for NHANES participants who wore accelerometers.
